titleEn: Bathroom Renovation in Richmond, BC in 2026: Real Costs and What to Expect
titleZh: 2026年BC省里士满浴室翻新：真实费用与预期指南
contentEn:
Richmond homeowners spent between $18,000 and $65,000 on full bathroom renovations in 2025, according to project records from local contractors. A standard 40–60 sq ft renovation with new tile, a walk-in shower, vanity, toilet, and basic plumbing updates typically lands in the $22,000–$35,000 range. High-end builds with heated floors, frameless glass, custom cabinetry, and premium fixtures regularly exceed $55,000.

What Drives the Cost of a Richmond Bathroom Renovation

Three factors most affect the final price in Richmond. First, plumbing relocation: moving a toilet or shower drain more than 3 feet adds $2,000–$6,000 because it requires breaking concrete. Second, fixture grade — a mid-range single-hole faucet costs $150–$400; a brushed nickel bridge faucet with custom finishes runs $600–$1,200. Third, tile area: heated floor underlays add $800–$2,200 per bathroom depending on size, and large-format porcelain tile with professional installation runs $18–$45 per square foot.

How Long Does a Bathroom Renovation Take in Richmond

A full gut renovation of a 60 sq ft bathroom takes 4–7 weeks on average. The longest phases are demo and plumbing (7–10 days), followed by tiling and cure time (10–14 days), then fixture installation and inspections (7–10 days). Richmond's City of Richmond building department typically processes plumbing permits within 5–10 business days. Scheduling the permit inspection before demo is critical — starting work without an approved permit risks a stop-work order.

Permits Required for a Richmond Bathroom Renovation

Any bathroom renovation involving plumbing work, structural changes, or electrical upgrades requires a City of Richmond building permit. Specific triggers include: moving any plumbing fixture (toilet, sink, shower), adding or replacing a tub, installing a heated floor (requires electrical permit), and rewiring bathroom circuits. Minor cosmetic updates — painting, swapping a vanity without moving plumbing, replacing a toilet — do not need a permit. A plumbing permit alone costs approximately $150–$300; combined electrical and plumbing permits run $300–$600. Your contractor should obtain the permit; verify the permit number on the City of Richmond online portal before work begins.

Real Project Examples from Richmond

A 55 sq ft master bathroom in Richmond's Terra West neighbourhood completed in early 2025 illustrates typical costs. The project included a curbless walk-in shower with frameless glass, double-sink floating vanity, heated tile floor, and new plumbing routed 4 feet from the original layout. Total cost was approximately $42,000 including permit and GST. Duration was six weeks from permit approval to final inspection.

Another Richmond project — a 35 sq ft hall bathroom in a 1990s Richmond Centre townhouse — involved new porcelain tile throughout, a soaking tub, wall-mounted vanity, and updated electrical for a humidity-sensor exhaust fan. The project cost approximately $24,500 and took five weeks. No structural changes were made, which simplified the permit process.

Choosing a Richmond Bathroom Contractor

Richmond bathroom renovation contractors must hold a valid Home Improvement Contractor registration with Consumer Protection BC and carry a minimum of $2 million general liability insurance. Verify the contractor's registration at consumerprotectionbc.ca. Ask for detailed scope-of-work quotes from at least three contractors — compare not just total price but the breakdown: demo, plumbing, electrical, tiling, fixtures, and permit costs listed separately.

Richmond Bathroom Renovation Cost Summary

Richmond bathroom renovation costs in 2026 fall into three tiers. Budget tier ($15,000–$22,000): replacement of fixtures, new flooring, fresh paint, and updated lighting — no plumbing relocation. Mid-range ($22,000–$38,000): includes new tile, walk-in shower, vanity upgrade, and minor plumbing reconfiguration within 3 feet. Premium ($38,000–$65,000+): curbless shower, heated floors, custom cabinetry, high-end fixtures, and full plumbing relocation. All prices exclude furniture, mirrors, and window treatments.

Frequently Asked Questions

Do I need a permit for a bathroom renovation in Richmond?

Yes, if your renovation involves moving plumbing fixtures, adding or replacing a tub or shower, installing a heated floor, or doing electrical work. Cosmetic updates like painting or replacing a vanity without plumbing changes do not require a permit. Always verify with the City of Richmond building department before starting work.

How long does a full bathroom renovation take in Richmond?

A full gut renovation typically takes 4–7 weeks from permit approval to final inspection. Demo and rough plumbing take 7–10 days; tiling and curing take 10–14 days; fixture installation and inspections take another 7–10 days. Richmond's permit processing adds 5–10 business days before work can start.

What does a mid-range bathroom renovation cost in Richmond?

A mid-range bathroom renovation in Richmond — new walk-in shower, updated vanity, tile flooring, and minor plumbing reconfiguration within 3 feet — typically costs $22,000–$38,000 in 2026. High-end projects with heated floors, custom cabinetry, and major plumbing relocation regularly exceed $55,000.

What plumbing permits does the City of Richmond require?

Any relocation of a toilet, sink, or shower requires a plumbing permit from the City of Richmond. Heated floor installations also require a separate electrical permit. Combined plumbing and electrical permits typically cost $300–$600. Your contractor should obtain and display the permit number before commencing work.

How do I verify a contractor is licensed in Richmond?

Check the contractor's Home Improvement Contractor registration at consumerprotectionbc.ca. Ensure they carry at least $2 million general liability insurance and ask for proof of Workers Compensation Board coverage. Get at least three written quotes with itemized scopes of work before signing a contract.

根据2025年本地承包商的项目记录，里士满（Richmond）屋主进行全套浴室翻新的费用在18,000至65,000加元之间。40至60平方英尺的标准翻新项目，包含新瓷砖、独立淋浴间洗手台马桶及基础管道改造，通常在22,000至35,000加元区间。高档装修项目，包括地暖、无框玻璃淋浴间、定制橱柜及高端五金配件，费用通常超过55,000加元。

影响里士满浴室翻新费用的主要因素

三个因素对里士满浴室翻新的最终价格影响最大。第一，管道移位：将马桶或淋浴排水管移动超过3英尺，需额外支付2,000至6,000加元，因为需要破坏混凝土。第二，五金配件等级——中档单孔水龙头价格150至400加元；带定制饰面的拉丝镍色复古水龙头价格600至1,200加元。第三，瓷砖铺设面积：地暖地垫每间浴室根据面积增加800至2,200加元，大规格瓷质瓷砖加专业铺设费用为每平方英尺18至45加元。

里士满浴室翻新需要多长时间

60平方英尺浴室的全面拆旧翻新平均需要4至7周。最耗时的阶段是拆旧和管道工程（7至10天），其次是瓷砖铺设和养护时间（10至14天），最后是五金安装和验收（7至10天）。里士满市建筑部门通常在5至10个工作日内处理管道许可证审批。在施工前提前预约许可验收至关重要——未获批准就开始工作可能面临停工令。

里士满浴室翻新所需许可证

任何涉及管道工程、结构改造或电气升级的浴室翻新均需获得里士满市建筑许可证。具体触发许可证要求的情况包括：移动任何管道设施（马桶、洗手池、淋浴）、新增或更换浴缸、安装地暖（需申请电气许可证）、以及重新布线浴室电路。轻微的 Cosmetic装修（如刷漆、在不移动管道的情况下更换洗手台、更换马桶）无需许可证。单独的管道许可证费用约150至300加元；电气和管道联合许可证费用为300至600加元。您的承包商应代为申请许可证；请在工程开工前通过里士满市在线门户验证许可证编号。

来自里士满的真实项目案例

2025年初完成的位于里士满Terra West社区的一个55平方英尺主卧浴室项目展示了典型费用。该项目包括无障碍步入式淋浴间、无框玻璃隔断、双盆悬浮式洗手台、地暖瓷砖地板，以及距原布局4英尺的新管道布线。总费用约42,000加元，包含许可证和GST。从许可证批准到最终验收共耗时六周。

另一个位于里士满中心1990年代联排别墅的35平方英尺公共浴室项目，包括全屋新瓷质瓷砖、新浸入式浴缸、壁挂式洗手台，以及为湿度感应排风扇更新的电气线路。工程费用约24,500加元，耗时五周。未进行结构改造，简化了许可证申请流程。

如何选择里士满浴室翻新承包商

里士满浴室翻新承包商必须持有BC省消费者保护局（Consumer Protection BC）有效的房屋改善承包商注册，并携带至少200万加元的一般责任保险。您可在consumerprotectionbc.ca验证承包商的注册状态。请至少向三位承包商索取详细的工作范围报价——不仅比较总价，还要比较明细：拆旧、管道、电气、瓷砖、五金和许可证费用分项列出。

里士满浴室翻新费用总结

2026年里士满浴室翻新费用分为三个档次。预算档次（15,000至22,000加元）：更换五金、新地板、粉刷墙面、更新照明——不涉及管道移位。中档（22,000至38,000加元）：包含新瓷砖、步入式淋浴间、洗手台升级、以及3英尺以内的管道小幅改位。高档（38,000至65,000加元以上）：无障碍淋浴间、地暖、定制橱柜、高端五金、以及管道全面移位。所有价格均不含家具、镜子和窗帘。

想在里士满、温哥华或大温地区规划浴室翻新？联系聚星装修获取免费、无约束的报价。我们的项目经理讲英语、普通话和粤语，已在里士满及周边社区完成超过100个浴室翻新项目。

常见问题

里士满浴室翻新需要申请许可证吗？

是的，如果您的翻新涉及移动管道设施、新增或更换浴缸或淋浴间、安装地暖或进行电气工程，则需要申请许可证。轻微的 Cosmetic装修（如刷漆、在不移动管道的情况下更换洗手台、更换马桶）无需许可证。在开工前请务必向里士满市建筑部门确认。

里士满全套浴室翻新需要多长时间？

全套拆旧翻新通常在许可证批准后需要4至7周。拆旧和粗管道工程需要7至10天；瓷砖铺设和养护需要10至14天；五金安装和验收需要7至10天。里士满的许可证审批流程在开工前额外增加5至10个工作日。

里士满中档浴室翻新费用是多少？

里士满中档浴室翻新——新步入式淋浴间、更新洗手台、瓷砖地板、以及3英尺以内的轻微管道改位——2026年典型费用为22,000至38,000加元。包含地暖、定制橱柜和主要管道移位的高档项目通常超过55,000加元。

里士满市要求哪些管道许可证？

移动马桶、洗手池或淋浴间需要向里士满市申请管道许可证。地暖安装还需单独的电气许可证。管道和电气联合许可证通常费用为300至600加元。您的承包商应在开工前申请并展示许可证编号。

如何验证承包商在里士满是否持有执照？

在consumerprotectionbc.ca检查承包商的房屋改善承包商注册状态。确保其持有至少200万加元的一般责任保险，并要求提供工伤赔偿委员会（Workers Compensation Board）保险证明。在签订合同前，请至少获取三份附有详细工作范围说明的书面报价。
